en.title: Rotating Chamber
en.desc: Tap the ↻ control inside a marked chamber to rotate that laboratory section 90° clockwise. Walls and atoms inside the chamber move to new grid cells. Every 90° turn costs 1 move. From level 552, A/B chambers can rotate independently; from 557, A/B/C chambers can appear, so the order of chamber turns can be part of the solution.

demo.result: The chamber rotates with its walls and atoms. Every tap costs 1 move.

en.title: Repulsor Core
en.desc: The Core is fixed inside a wall cell. Slide an atom into one of the four glowing cells beside it: the field instantly pushes the atom directly AWAY from the Core, and it keeps sliding in that new direction. A Core can redirect the same move only once.

demo.result: When the atom enters a cell beside the Core, it turns directly away from the Core and keeps sliding in the new direction until blocked.

en.title: Element Synthesizer
en.desc: The target atom is missing. Feed the two calibrated input atoms through Σ; both are consumed and ONE entirely new element appears on the marked output cell. This is fictional Moleculox high-energy experimental transmutation, inspired by nuclear synthesis—not an ordinary chemical reaction.

demo.result: A and B are fully consumed; C appears as a new element on the output cell. This is not Fusion: the inputs do not remain inside a structure. It is not Replicator either: no identical copy is made.

en.title: Photon Boost
en.desc: Slide an atom through the glowing hν Photon Pad to charge it. A glowing charged atom can pass through exactly ONE blocking atom, then the charge disappears. If it does not pass an atom yet, the charge stays for the next move.

demo.result: The atom glows. This charge lets it phase through one other atom once; it disappears after the pass. If unused, the charge stays for the next move.

en.title: Molecular Replicator
en.desc: The target is missing an atom. Slide the correct atom through the glowing ×2 chamber: the original keeps moving and one matching copy appears on the marked output cell. The chamber stops once the target atom count is reached.

demo.result: The original keeps sliding; one matching copy appears on the marked output cell.

en.title: Frozen atom
en.desc: A frozen atom cannot move. Build around it, or bring a fire atom next to it to melt the ice.

demo.result: The frozen atom stays put; build the molecule around it.

en.title: Fire atom
en.desc: A fire atom melts any frozen atom directly beside it. Move it into contact to open the route.

demo.result: Contact with fire melts the ice and frees the atom.

en.title: Lightning atom
en.desc: The ⚡ symbol means this atom carries an electric charge. When it touches a connected atom group, the pulse travels through the chain and thaws every frozen atom it reaches.

demo.result: The ⚡ symbol marks electric charge. Energy travels through the connected group and thaws the ice.

en.title: Sticky atom
en.desc: The first movable atom that touches it forms a rigid two-atom pair. The pair can still move, but both atoms slide together and stop when either side is blocked.

demo.result: The touching atom sticks at that point and cannot separate.

en.title: Unstable atom
en.desc: The fixed double orbit and fractured energy core mark an unstable atom. Contact can transfer instability up to two times; heat or electrical charge stabilizes it.

demo.result: Contact transfers instability. Heat or electrical charge stabilizes the atom.

en.title: One-way floor
en.desc: An atom sliding onto the arrow can only keep going that direction — it can never come back the way it came.

demo.result: You may pass with the arrow, but cannot return against it.

en.title: Breakable wall
en.desc: Only cracked walls can be broken. Hammers come from your Lab inventory; each real use consumes 1 Hammer. The training example is free.

demo.result: Select the hammer in the bottom toolbar, then tap the cracked wall.

en.title: Portal
en.desc: Portals are marked A and B. Stop an atom on one portal to send it to the empty matching portal.

demo.result: The atom enters portal A and exits its linked portal B.

en.title: Rift passage
en.desc: Unlike a normal portal, a Rift Portal triggers while an atom is crossing its tile. The atom warps to the linked Rift and keeps sliding in the SAME direction. One Rift pair can trigger only once during a single move.

demo.result: The atom does not need to stop on the Rift; crossing it warps to the twin Rift and continues in the same direction.

en.title: Moving wall
en.desc: The wall marked ↔ moves to the next rail position after each completed move. Plan for where it will be next.

demo.result: The wall advances to its next patterned position after a move.

en.title: Button and door
en.desc: The round switch and its door share the same letter. The transparent striped square is an OPEN door; when the atom leaves the switch, it becomes a solid wall again.

demo.result: The striped square with the same letter is the open door. It becomes a solid wall when the atom leaves switch A.

en.title: Fragile atom
en.desc: The number beside the diamond shows remaining hard impacts. Each hard stop removes one; at zero it shatters and the experiment restarts.

demo.result: Too many impacts shatter it; use a short, clean route.

en.title: Linked atoms
en.desc: Atoms joined by the animated dotted line move together in the same direction. BOTH routes must be clear.

demo.result: Moving either one sends its mate in the same direction. Both paths must be clear.

en.title: Molecular Fusion
en.desc: Complete the highlighted sub-structures anywhere on the board. Once a valid part forms, its atoms lock into a rigid molecular group and slide together. Build the final target anywhere; no fixed finish tile is required.

demo.result: Once a valid sub-structure forms, it becomes a rigid group and slides together. You may complete the final molecule anywhere on the board.

en.title: Prebuilt Module
en.desc: A highlighted molecular fragment begins already stabilized and moves as one rigid unit. Keep it intact, move it if needed, and attach the remaining atoms anywhere the final target fits.

demo.result: The highlighted fragment is rigid from the start. Move it as one piece and place the remaining atoms around it.

en.title: Rotation Pad
en.desc: Stop a completed Fusion group on the rotating floor pad. The pad turns that rigid molecular group 90° clockwise around the atom on the pad. If the rotated shape would hit a wall or another atom, the turn is blocked.

demo.result: The rigid Fusion group rotates 90° around the atom on the pad.

en.title: One-Square Move
en.desc: This is an optional booster, not the main objective. Activate it, select an atom, then choose a direction to move exactly ONE tile.

demo.result: This optional tool moves an atom exactly one tile. A confirmed use costs 250 MoleCoin.

en.title: Chain reaction
en.desc: The gold » marks a chain starter. Move it in the indicated direction to trigger the next moves automatically and build a combo. The blue ⚡ thaws frozen atoms.

demo.result: The correct move starts the automatic chain reaction.

en.title: Reactor lasers
en.desc: Move while the laser is dim/off. Touching an active beam counts as one move and raises the Impact counter; Reactor Escape also adds 3 seconds.

demo.result: Contact with an active laser counts as one move and increases the Impact counter. Reactor Escape also adds a 3-second penalty.

tr.title: Döner Laboratuvar
tr.desc: İşaretli bir odanın içindeki ↻ simgesine dokunarak o laboratuvar bölümünü 90° saat yönünde döndür. Odanın içindeki duvarlar ve atomlar gerçekten yeni hücrelere taşınır. Her 90° dönüş 1 hamledir. 552’den itibaren A/B, 557’den itibaren A/B/C odaları bağımsız dönebilir; bu yüzden odaları hangi sırayla döndürdüğün çözümün bir parçasıdır.

demo.result: Oda, duvarlar ve içindeki atomlarla birlikte döner. Her dokunuş 1 hamledir.

tr.title: İtici Çekirdek
tr.desc: Çekirdek sabit bir duvar hücresinin içindedir. Bir atomu çevresindeki dört parlayan hücreden birine kaydır: alan atomu anında Çekirdekten UZAĞA iter ve atom yeni yönde kaymaya devam eder. Aynı Çekirdek bir hamleyi yalnız bir kez yönlendirir.

demo.result: Atom çekirdeğin yanındaki hücreye girince çekirdekten uzağa döner ve yeni yönde duvara kadar kaymayı sürdürür.

tr.title: Element Sentezleyici
tr.desc: Hedef atom eksik. Kalibre edilmiş iki giriş atomunu Σ üzerinden geçir; ikisi de tüketilir ve işaretli çıkış hücresinde tamamen YENİ bir element oluşur. Bu normal kimyasal reaksiyon değil; nükleer sentezden esinlenen kurgusal, yüksek enerjili Moleculox element dönüşümüdür.

demo.result: A ve B tamamen tüketilir; C çıkış hücresinde yeni bir element olarak oluşur. Bu Fusion değildir: girişler yeni yapının içinde kalmaz. Replicator da değildir: aynı atom kopyalanmaz.

tr.title: Foton Güçlendirme
tr.desc: Bir atomu parlayan hν Foton Pedi üzerinden kaydırarak yükle. Parlayan yüklü atom tam BİR engelleyici atomun içinden geçebilir; geçişten sonra yük biter. Henüz bir atomun içinden geçmezse yük sonraki hamleye kalır.

demo.result: Atom parlar. Bu yük bir kez başka bir atomun içinden geçmeni sağlar; geçişten sonra söner. Kullanmazsan yük sonraki hamleye kalır.

tr.title: Moleküler Çoğaltıcı
tr.desc: Hedefte eksik bir atom var. Doğru atomı parlayan ×2 odasından geçir: orijinal atom kaymaya devam eder, aynı atomdan bir kopya işaretli çıkış hücresinde oluşur. Hedefteki atom sayısına ulaşınca cihaz durur.

demo.result: Orijinal atom yoluna devam eder; aynı elementten bir kopya işaretli çıkış hücresinde oluşur.

tr.title: Donmuş atom
tr.desc: Donmuş atom hareket etmez. Molekülü çevresinde kur veya yanına ateş atomu getirerek buzu erit.

demo.result: Donmuş atom yerinde kalır; molekül onun çevresinde kurulur.

tr.title: Ateş atomu
tr.desc: Ateş atomu hemen yanındaki donmuş atomu eritir. Yolu açmak için ikisini temas ettir.

demo.result: Ateş temas edince buz erir ve atom serbest kalır.

tr.title: Şimşek atomu
tr.desc: ⚡ işareti atomun elektrik yüklü olduğunu gösterir. Bağlı bir atom grubuna değdiğinde enerji zincir boyunca ilerler ve ulaştığı tüm donmuş atomları çözer.

demo.result: ⚡ işareti elektrik yükünü gösterir. Enerji bağlı grup boyunca ilerleyip buzu çözer.

tr.title: Yapışkan atom
tr.desc: Ona ilk temas eden hareketli atomla iki atomlu sert bir çift oluşturur. Çift hareket etmeye devam eder; ancak iki atom birlikte kayar ve taraflardan biri engellenince ikisi de durur.

demo.result: Temas eden atom o noktada yapışır; geri ayrılamaz.

tr.title: Kararsız atom
tr.desc: Sabit çift yörünge ve çatlak enerji çekirdeği kararsız atomu gösterir. Temasla kararsızlığı en fazla iki kez aktarır; ısı veya elektrik yükü yeniden dengeler.

demo.result: Temas kararsızlığı aktarır. Isı veya elektrik yükü atomu stabilize eder.

tr.title: Tek yönlü zemin
tr.desc: Oka doğru kayan bir atom sadece o yönde devam edebilir — geldiği yöne asla geri dönemez.

demo.result: Ok yönünde geçebilirsin; ters yönden geri dönemezsin.

tr.title: Kırılabilir duvar
tr.desc: Yalnız çatlak duvarlar kırılabilir. Çekiçler Laboratuvar envanterinden gelir; gerçek kullanımda 1 Çekiç harcanır. Eğitim örneği ücretsizdir.

demo.result: Alt araç çubuğundaki çekici seç, sonra çatlak duvara dokun.

tr.title: Portal
tr.desc: Portallar A ve B harfiyle işaretlidir. Bir atomu portalın üzerinde durdurunca boş olan eş portala ışınlanır.

demo.result: Atom A portalından girip eşleşen B portalından çıkar.

tr.title: Rift geçidi
tr.desc: Normal portalın aksine Rift Portal, atom karo üzerinden geçerken tetiklenir. Atom eş Rift’e ışınlanır ve AYNI yönde kaymaya devam eder. Sonsuz döngüyü önlemek için aynı Rift çifti bir hamlede yalnız bir kez tetiklenir.

demo.result: 금색 » 표시는 연쇄 시작점을 뜻합니다. 표시된 방향으로 움직이면 다음 이동들이 자동으로 실행되어 콤보가 만들어집니다. 파란 ⚡는 얼어붙은 원자를 녹입니다.

ko.title: 원자로 레이저
ko.desc: 레이저가 어둡거나 꺼졌을 때 움직이세요. 활성 광선에 닿으면 이동 1회로 계산되고 충돌 카운터가 증가합니다. 원자로 탈출에서는 3초도 추가됩니다.

ru.title: Rotating Chamber
ru.desc: Нажмите ↻ внутри отмеченной камеры, чтобы повернуть этот участок лаборатории на 90° по часовой стрелке. Стены и атомы внутри действительно переходят в новые клетки. Каждый поворот на 90° стоит 1 ход. С уровня 552 камеры A/B вращаются независимо, а с 557 могут появляться A/B/C, поэтому порядок поворотов становится частью решения.

demo.result: Нажмите ↻ внутри отмеченной камеры, чтобы повернуть этот участок лаборатории на 90° по часовой стрелке. Стены и атомы внутри действительно переходят в новые клетки. Каждый поворот на 90° стоит 1 ход. С уровня 552 камеры A/B вращаются независимо, а с 557 могут появляться A/B/C, поэтому порядок поворотов становится частью решения.

ru.title: Repulsor Core
ru.desc: Ядро закреплено внутри клетки стены. Направьте атом в одну из четырёх светящихся соседних клеток: поле мгновенно толкнёт атом ПРОЧЬ от ядра, и он продолжит скользить в новом направлении. Одно ядро может перенаправить один ход только один раз.

demo.result: Ядро закреплено внутри клетки стены. Направьте атом в одну из четырёх светящихся соседних клеток: поле мгновенно толкнёт атом ПРОЧЬ от ядра, и он продолжит скользить в новом направлении. Одно ядро может перенаправить один ход только один раз.

ru.title: Element Synthesizer
ru.desc: The target atom is missing. Feed the two calibrated input atoms through Σ; both are consumed and ONE entirely new element appears on the marked output cell. This is fictional Moleculox high-energy experimental transmutation, inspired by nuclear synthesis—not an ordinary chemical reaction.

demo.result: The target atom is missing. Feed the two calibrated input atoms through Σ; both are consumed and ONE entirely new element appears on the marked output cell. ru.title: Photon Boost
ru.desc: Slide an atom through the glowing hν Photon Pad to charge it. A glowing charged atom can pass through exactly ONE blocking atom, then the charge disappears. If it does not pass an atom yet, the charge stays for the next move.

demo.result: Slide an atom through the glowing hν Photon Pad to charge it. A glowing charged atom can pass through exactly ONE blocking atom, then the charge disappears. If it does not pass an atom yet, the charge stays for the next move.

ru.title: Molecular Replicator
ru.desc: The target is missing an atom. Slide the correct atom through the glowing ×2 chamber: the original keeps moving and one matching copy appears on the marked output cell. The chamber stops once the target atom count is reached.

demo.result: The target is missing an atom. Slide the correct atom through the glowing ×2 chamber: the original keeps moving and one matching copy appears on the marked output cell. The chamber stops once the target atom count is reached.

ru.title: Замороженный атом
ru.desc: Замороженный атом не может двигаться. Постройте вокруг него что-нибудь или поднесите к нему огненный атом, чтобы растопить лед.

demo.result: Замороженный атом не может двигаться. Постройте вокруг него что-нибудь или поднесите к нему огненный атом, чтобы растопить лед.

ru.title: Огненный атом
ru.desc: Атом огня расплавляет любой замерзший атом, находящийся непосредственно рядом с ним. Приведите его в контакт, чтобы открыть путь.

demo.result: Атом огня расплавляет любой замерзший атом, находящийся непосредственно рядом с ним. Приведите его в контакт, чтобы открыть путь.

ru.title: Атом молнии
ru.desc: Символ ⚡ означает, что этот атом несёт электрический заряд. При соприкосновении с группой связанных атомов импульс проходит через цепочку и размораживает каждый замороженный атом, до которого доходит.

ru.title: Липкий атом
ru.desc: Первый подвижный атом, коснувшийся его, образует жесткую пару из двух атомов. Эта пара все еще может двигаться, но оба атома скользят вместе и останавливаются, когда одна из сторон оказывается заблокирована.

demo.result: Первый подвижный атом, коснувшийся его, образует жесткую пару из двух атомов. Эта пара все еще может двигаться, но оба атома скользят вместе и останавливаются, когда одна из сторон оказывается заблокирована.

ru.title: Unstable atom
ru.desc: The fixed double orbit and fractured energy core mark an unstable atom. Contact can transfer instability up to two times; heat or electrical charge stabilizes it.

demo.result: The fixed double orbit and fractured energy core mark an unstable atom. Contact can transfer instability up to two times; heat or electrical charge stabilizes it.

ru.title: Пол с односторонним движением
ru.desc: Атом, скользящий по стрелке, может продолжать двигаться только в этом направлении — он никогда не сможет вернуться тем же путем, которым пришел.

demo.result: Атом, скользящий по стрелке, может продолжать двигаться только в этом направлении — он никогда не сможет вернуться тем же путем, которым пришел.

ru.title: Разрушаемая стена
ru.desc: Only cracked walls can be broken. Hammers come from your Lab inventory; each real use consumes 1 Hammer. The training example is free.

demo.result: Only cracked walls can be broken. Hammers come from your Lab inventory; each real use consumes 1 Hammer. The training example is free.

ru.title: Портал
ru.desc: Порталы обозначены буквами A и B. Остановите атом на одном из порталов, чтобы отправить его в соответствующий пустой портал.

demo.result: Порталы обозначены буквами A и B. Остановите атом на одном из порталов, чтобы отправить его в соответствующий пустой портал.

ru.title: Rift passage
ru.desc: Unlike a normal portal, a Rift Portal triggers while an atom is crossing its tile. The atom warps to the linked Rift and keeps sliding in the SAME direction. One Rift pair can trigger only once during a single move.

demo.result: Unlike a normal portal, a Rift Portal triggers while an atom is crossing its tile. The atom warps to the linked Rift and keeps sliding in the SAME direction. One Rift pair can trigger only once during a single move.

ru.title: Движущаяся стена
ru.desc: Стенка, отмеченная знаком ↔, перемещается на следующую позицию рельса после каждого завершенного перемещения. Спланируйте, где она окажется в следующий раз.

demo.result: Стенка, отмеченная знаком ↔, перемещается на следующую позицию рельса после каждого завершенного перемещения. Спланируйте, где она окажется в следующий раз.

ru.title: Кнопка и дверь
ru.desc: Круглый выключатель и его дверца имеют одну и ту же букву. Прозрачный полосатый квадрат — это ОТКРЫТАЯ дверца; когда атом покидает выключатель, он снова превращается в твердую стену.

ru.title: Хрупкий атом
ru.desc: Число рядом с ромбом показывает оставшееся количество сильных ударов. Каждый сильный удар уменьшает количество ударов на один; при достижении нуля ромб разбивается, и эксперимент начинается заново.

ru.title: Связанные атомы
ru.desc: Атомы, соединенные анимированной пунктирной линией, движутся вместе в одном направлении. Оба пути должны быть свободны.

demo.result: Атомы, соединенные анимированной пунктирной линией, движутся вместе в одном направлении. Оба пути должны быть свободны.

ru.title: Molecular Fusion
ru.desc: Complete the highlighted sub-structures anywhere on the board. Once a valid part forms, its atoms lock into a rigid molecular group and slide together. Build the final target anywhere; no fixed finish tile is required.

demo.result: Complete the highlighted sub-structures anywhere on the board. Once a valid part forms, its atoms lock into a rigid molecular group and slide together. Build the final target anywhere; no fixed finish tile is required.

ru.title: Prebuilt Module
ru.desc: A highlighted molecular fragment begins already stabilized and moves as one rigid unit. Keep it intact, move it if needed, and attach the remaining atoms anywhere the final target fits.

demo.result: A highlighted molecular fragment begins already stabilized and moves as one rigid unit. Keep it intact, move it if needed, and attach the remaining atoms anywhere the final target fits.

ru.title: Rotation Pad
ru.desc: Stop a completed Fusion group on the rotating floor pad. The pad turns that rigid molecular group 90° clockwise around the atom on the pad. If the rotated shape would hit a wall or another atom, the turn is blocked.

demo.result: Stop a completed Fusion group on the rotating floor pad. The pad turns that rigid molecular group 90° clockwise around the atom on the pad. If the rotated shape would hit a wall or another atom, the turn is blocked.

ru.title: Перемещение на одну клетку
ru.desc: Это необязательный усилитель, а не основная цель. Активируйте его, выберите атом, затем выберите направление, чтобы переместиться ровно на ОДНУ клетку.

ru.title: Миссия «Катализатор»
ru.desc: Соберите три символа на игровом поле — Катализатор, Энергетическая ячейка и Стабилизатор. Их фишки вверху превращаются в галочки; затем завершите сборку молекулы.

ru.title: Цепная реакция
ru.desc: The gold » marks a chain starter. Move it in the indicated direction to trigger the next moves automatically and build a combo. The blue ⚡ thaws frozen atoms.

demo.result: The gold » marks a chain starter. Move it in the indicated direction to trigger the next moves automatically and build a combo. The blue ⚡ thaws frozen atoms.

ru.title: Реакторные лазеры
ru.desc: Перемещайтесь, когда лазер приглушен/выключен. Касание активного луча засчитывается как одно перемещение и увеличивает счетчик ударов; побег из реактора также добавляет 3 секунды.

en.title: Hint
en.desc: One tap opens the hint menu. Each level’s first Strategic Clue is free and does not reset on restart; stronger Exact Move and remaining-solution options use MoleCoin.

en.title: Undo
en.desc: Reverses the last normal move. Used Hammer and One-Square Move items are not restored; MoleCoin spent on a placed Nano Barrier is not refunded.

en.title: Restart
en.desc: Returns the level to its starting layout. Consumed support items are not restored.

en.title: Hammer
en.desc: Hammer is available only in levels with a cracked wall. Select it, then tap the cracked wall. The training example is free; real use consumes 1 hammer.

en.title: One-Square Move
en.desc: Select the tool, choose an atom and a direction. The atom moves exactly one square. If the experiment does not support the tool, Dr. Edward Atom tells you clearly. The training example is free.

en.title: Nano Barrier
en.desc: In supported levels, Nano Barrier is placed on an empty normal tile. Confirming costs 500 MoleCoin; it breaks on the first atom collision and can be used only once per level. Dr. Edward Atom clearly tells you when an experiment does not allow it.

en.title: Laboratory and Supports
en.desc: Hammer is bought in the Laboratory. One-Square Move costs 250 MoleCoin per confirmed use, while Nano Barrier costs 500 MoleCoin per confirmed placement on a supported board. Permanent equipment reduces hint costs or increases rewards.

tr.title: İpucu
tr.desc: Tek dokunuşla ipucu menüsü açılır. Her bölümün ilk Stratejik İpucu ücretsizdir ve yeniden başlatınca yenilenmez; daha güçlü kesin hamle ve kalan çözüm seçenekleri MoleCoin kullanır.

tr.title: Geri Al
tr.desc: Son normal hamleyi geri çevirir. Kullanılmış Çekiç ve Tek Kare Hareket geri dönmez; yerleştirilmiş Nano Bariyer için harcanan MoleCoin iade edilmez.

tr.title: Yeniden Başlat
tr.desc: Bölümü başlangıç düzenine döndürür. Harcanan destekler geri verilmez.

tr.title: Çekiç
tr.desc: Çekiç yalnız çatlak duvar bulunan bölümlerde verilir. Aracı seç, ardından çatlak duvara dokun. Eğitim örneği ücretsizdir; gerçek kullanımda 1 çekiç harcanır.

tr.title: Tek Kare Hareket
tr.desc: Aracı seç, atomu seç ve yön ver. Atom yalnızca 1 kare ilerler. Bu deney aracı desteklemiyorsa Dr. Edward Atom bunu açıkça söyler. Eğitim örneği ücretsizdir.

tr.title: Nano Bariyer
tr.desc: Nano Bariyer desteklenen bölümlerde boş ve normal bir kareye yerleştirilir. Onayda 500 MoleCoin harcanır; ilk atom çarpışmasında kırılır ve bölüm başına yalnızca bir kez kullanılabilir. Kullanılamayan deneylerde Dr. Edward Atom bunu açıkça söyler.

tr.title: Laboratuvar ve Destekler
tr.desc: Çekiç Laboratuvardan alınır. Tek Kare Hareket onaylanan kullanımda 250 MoleCoin, Nano Bariyer ise desteklenen tahtada onaylanan yerleştirmede 500 MoleCoin’dir. Kalıcı cihazlar ipucu fiyatını düşürür veya ödülleri artırır.

de.title: Hinweis
de.desc: Ein Tippen öffnet das Hinweismenü. Der erste strategische Hinweis jedes Levels ist kostenlos und wird beim Neustart nicht erneuert; stärkere Hilfen kosten MoleCoin.

de.title: Rückgängig
de.desc: Macht den letzten normalen Zug rückgängig. Benutzter Hammer und Ein-Feld-Zug werden nicht zurückgegeben; MoleCoin für eine platzierte Nano-Barriere werden nicht erstattet.

de.title: Neu starten
de.desc: Setzt das Level auf die Startanordnung zurück. Verbrauchte Hilfen werden nicht erstattet.

de.title: Hammer
de.desc: Der Hammer ist nur in Levels mit einer rissigen Wand verfügbar. Wähle ihn und tippe dann auf die rissige Wand. Das Training ist kostenlos; im echten Level wird 1 Hammer verbraucht.

de.title: Ein-Feld-Zug
de.desc: Wähle Werkzeug, Atom und Richtung. Das Atom bewegt sich genau ein Feld. Unterstützt das Experiment das Werkzeug nicht, sagt Dr. Edward Atom es ausdrücklich. Das Training ist kostenlos.

de.title: Nano-Barriere
de.desc: In unterstützten Levels wird die Nano-Barriere auf ein leeres normales Feld gesetzt. Die Bestätigung kostet 500 MoleCoin; sie zerbricht beim ersten Atomaufprall und ist nur einmal pro Level nutzbar. Dr. Edward Atom sagt klar, wenn sie in einem Experiment nicht erlaubt ist.

de.title: Labor und Hilfen
de.desc: Der Hammer wird im Labor gekauft. Ein bestätigter Ein-Feld-Zug kostet 250 MoleCoin; eine bestätigte Nano-Barriere auf einem unterstützten Brett kostet 500 MoleCoin. Dauerhafte Geräte senken Hinweiskosten oder erhöhen Belohnungen.

es.title: Pista
es.desc: Un toque abre el menú de pistas. La primera pista estratégica de cada nivel es gratis y no se renueva al reiniciar; las ayudas más fuertes usan MoleCoin.

es.title: Deshacer
es.desc: Revierte el último movimiento normal. Los usos de Martillo y Movimiento de una casilla no se recuperan; los MoleCoin gastados en una Barrera nano colocada no se reembolsan.

es.title: Reiniciar
es.desc: Devuelve el nivel a su disposición inicial. Las ayudas gastadas no se recuperan.

es.title: Martillo
es.desc: El Martillo solo está disponible en niveles con una pared agrietada. Selecciónalo y toca esa pared. El ejemplo de práctica es gratis; el uso real consume 1 martillo.

es.title: Movimiento de una casilla
es.desc: Selecciona la herramienta, un átomo y una dirección. El átomo avanza exactamente una casilla. Si el experimento no admite la herramienta, Dr. Edward Atom te lo dirá claramente. El ejemplo es gratis.

es.title: Barrera nano
es.desc: En niveles compatibles, la Barrera nano se coloca en una casilla normal vacía. Confirmar cuesta 500 MoleCoin; se rompe con el primer choque y solo puede usarse una vez por nivel. Dr. Edward Atom avisa claramente cuando un experimento no la permite.

es.title: Laboratorio y ayudas
es.desc: El Martillo se compra en el Laboratorio. Un Movimiento de una casilla confirmado cuesta 250 MoleCoin; colocar una Barrera nano confirmada en un tablero compatible cuesta 500 MoleCoin. El equipo permanente reduce el coste de pistas o aumenta recompensas.

pt.title: Dica
pt.desc: Um toque abre o menu de dicas. A primeira dica estratégica de cada fase é grátis e não volta ao reiniciar; ajudas mais fortes usam MoleCoin.

pt.title: Desfazer
pt.desc: Desfaz o último movimento normal. Martelo e Movimento de uma casa usados não são devolvidos; MoleCoin gastos em uma Barreira Nano colocada não são reembolsados.

pt.title: Reiniciar
pt.desc: Retorna a fase à configuração inicial. Os suportes gastos não são devolvidos.

pt.title: Martelo
pt.desc: O Martelo só fica disponível em fases com uma parede rachada. Selecione-o e toque nessa parede. O treino é grátis; o uso real consome 1 martelo.

pt.title: Movimento de uma casa
pt.desc: Selecione a ferramenta, um átomo e uma direção. O átomo avança exatamente uma casa. Se o experimento não aceitar a ferramenta, Dr. Edward Atom avisará claramente. O exemplo é grátis.

pt.title: Barreira nano
pt.desc: Nas fases compatíveis, a Barreira Nano é colocada em uma casa normal vazia. Confirmar custa 500 MoleCoin; ela quebra na primeira colisão e só pode ser usada uma vez por fase. Dr. Edward Atom avisa claramente quando o experimento não permite seu uso.

pt.title: Laboratório e suportes
pt.desc: O Martelo é comprado no Laboratório. Um Movimento de uma casa confirmado custa 250 MoleCoin; uma Barreira Nano confirmada em um tabuleiro compatível custa 500 MoleCoin. Equipamentos permanentes reduzem custos de dicas ou aumentam recompensas.

ja.title: ヒント
ja.desc: 1回タップするとヒントメニューが開きます。各レベル最初の戦略ヒントは無料で、再スタートしても復活しません。より強いヒントにはMoleCoinを使います。

ja.title: 元に戻す
ja.desc: 直前の通常手を戻します。使用済みのハンマーと1マス移動は戻らず、設置済みナノバリアに使ったMoleCoinも返却されません。

ja.title: やり直す
ja.desc: レベルを開始時の配置に戻します。消費したサポートは戻りません。

ja.title: ハンマー
ja.desc: ハンマーはひび割れ壁があるレベルでのみ使用できます。選択して壁をタップします。練習は無料ですが、実戦では1個消費します。

ja.title: 1マス移動
ja.desc: ツール、原子、方向を選ぶと、原子がちょうど1マス移動します。この実験で使えない場合はDr. Edward Atomが明確に知らせます。練習は無料です。

ja.title: ナノバリア
ja.desc: 対応レベルでは、ナノバリアを空いている通常マスに設置します。確定時に500 MoleCoinを消費し、最初の原子衝突で壊れ、1レベルにつき1回だけ使えます。使えない実験ではDr. Edward Atomが明確に知らせます。

ja.title: ラボとサポート
ja.desc: ハンマーはラボで購入します。1マス移動は確定使用ごとに250 MoleCoin、ナノバリアは対応盤面で確定設置ごとに500 MoleCoinです。常設装置はヒント費用を下げたり報酬を増やしたりします。

fr.title: Indice
fr.desc: Un toucher ouvre le menu des indices. Le premier indice stratégique de chaque niveau est gratuit et ne revient pas après redémarrage ; les aides plus fortes utilisent des MoleCoin.

fr.title: Annuler
fr.desc: Annule le dernier coup normal. Le Marteau et le déplacement d’une case consommés ne sont pas rendus ; les MoleCoin dépensés pour une Nano-Barrière placée ne sont pas remboursés.

fr.title: Recommencer
fr.desc: Remet le niveau dans sa configuration de départ. Les aides déjà consommées ne sont pas restituées.

fr.title: Marteau
fr.desc: Le Marteau n’est disponible que dans les niveaux comportant un mur fissuré. Sélectionne-le puis touche ce mur. L’entraînement est gratuit ; l’usage réel consomme 1 Marteau.

fr.title: Déplacement d’une case
fr.desc: Sélectionne l’outil, un atome et une direction. L’atome avance exactement d’une case. Si l’expérience n’autorise pas cet outil, Dr. Edward Atom te le dira clairement. L’entraînement est gratuit.

fr.title: Nano-Barrière
fr.desc: Dans les niveaux compatibles, la Nano-Barrière se place sur une case normale vide. La confirmation coûte 500 MoleCoin ; elle se brise au premier choc d’atome et n’est utilisable qu’une fois par niveau. Dr. Edward Atom indique clairement lorsqu’une expérience ne l’autorise pas.

fr.title: Laboratoire et aides
fr.desc: Le Marteau s’achète au Laboratoire. Un déplacement d’une case confirmé coûte 250 MoleCoin ; une Nano-Barrière confirmée sur un plateau compatible coûte 500 MoleCoin. Les équipements permanents réduisent le coût des indices ou augmentent les récompenses.

zh.title: 提示
zh.desc: 轻触一次即可打开提示菜单。每关第一次策略提示免费，重新开始也不会恢复；更强的提示会消耗MoleCoin。

zh.title: 撤销
zh.desc: 撤销上一步普通移动。已使用的锤子和单格移动不会返还；已放置纳米屏障消耗的MoleCoin也不会退款。

zh.title: 重新开始
zh.desc: 将关卡恢复到初始布局。已消耗的辅助道具不会返还。

zh.title: 锤子
zh.desc: 锤子只会在存在裂纹墙的关卡中提供。选择锤子后点击裂纹墙。训练示例免费；实战每次消耗1把锤子。

zh.title: 单格移动
zh.desc: 选择工具、原子和方向后，原子会精确移动一格。如果本实验不支持该工具，Dr. Edward Atom会明确告诉你。训练示例免费。

zh.title: 纳米屏障
zh.desc: 在支持的关卡中，纳米屏障可放在空的普通格子上。确认时消耗500 MoleCoin；第一次原子碰撞时破碎，每关只能使用一次。若实验不允许使用，Dr. Edward Atom会明确说明。

zh.title: 实验室与辅助
zh.desc: 锤子可在实验室购买。单格移动每次确认使用需250 MoleCoin；纳米屏障在支持的棋盘上每次确认放置需500 MoleCoin。永久设备可降低提示费用或提高奖励。

it.title: Suggerimento
it.desc: Un tocco apre il menu dei suggerimenti. Il primo indizio strategico di ogni livello è gratis e non torna riavviando; gli aiuti più forti usano MoleCoin.

it.title: Annulla
it.desc: Annulla l’ultima mossa normale. Martello e Mossa di una casella consumati non vengono restituiti; i MoleCoin spesi per una Nano Barriera già posizionata non vengono rimborsati.

it.title: Ricomincia
it.desc: Riporta il livello alla disposizione iniziale. I supporti già consumati non vengono restituiti.

it.title: Martello
it.desc: Il Martello è disponibile solo nei livelli con un muro crepato. Selezionalo e tocca quel muro. L’esempio di allenamento è gratuito; l’uso reale consuma 1 Martello.

it.title: Mossa di una casella
it.desc: Seleziona lo strumento, un atomo e una direzione. L’atomo si muove esattamente di una casella. Se l’esperimento non supporta lo strumento, Dr. Edward Atom te lo dirà chiaramente. L’allenamento è gratuito.

it.title: Nano Barriera
it.desc: Nei livelli compatibili, la Nano Barriera si posiziona su una casella normale vuota. La conferma costa 500 MoleCoin; si rompe al primo urto di un atomo e può essere usata una sola volta per livello. Dr. Edward Atom avvisa chiaramente quando l’esperimento non la consente.

it.title: Laboratorio e supporti
it.desc: Il Martello si acquista nel Laboratorio. Una Mossa di una casella confermata costa 250 MoleCoin; una Nano Barriera confermata su una tavola compatibile costa 500 MoleCoin. Le attrezzature permanenti riducono il costo dei suggerimenti o aumentano le ricompense.

ko.title: Hint
ko.desc: One tap opens the hint menu. Each level’s first Strategic Clue is free and does not reset on restart; stronger Exact Move and remaining-solution options use MoleCoin.

en.title: HOW TO PLAY MOLECULOX?
en.html:
⚛️ Push atoms, build molecules, save science!Tap an atom and choose a direction. It slides until an obstacle.

🎯 CORE GOAL

  • Build the 2D molecule layout shown on the GOAL card.
  • Finish at or below PAR to earn 3 stars.
  • Undo and Restart do not erase campaign progress.

🧪 SPECIAL MECHANICS

  • ❄️ Frozen atoms stay put; 🔥 Fire melts ice.
  • ⚡ Electricity travels through connected groups.
  • 🍯 Sticky atoms move together after bonding.
  • Portal A/B transports atoms; switches open doors; lasers reward safe timing.
  • 🧩 Fusion, Rotation Pads, and Prebuilt Modules work with rigid molecular groups.
  • 🌀 Rift Portals, Enzyme Gates, and Bio Assembly unlock in advanced research; their first levels teach the rule.
  • 🧰 Lab Tools can help when needed; Dr. Edward Atom may remind you about them if you get stuck.

🏆 PROGRESSION

  • 801 main experiments, Bonus Lab, Daily Experiment, and Atom Duel are available.
  • Moleculopedia stores discovered molecule and element information.
  • Link a permanent account to protect progress across devices.

⚔️ ATOM DUEL · RATING & REWARDS

Quick Match is ranked. Friend rooms created with a code and two-player duels on the same phone are unranked.

WIN+25 DPDRAW+3 DPLOSS−10 DP
  • DP determines your Duel League from Bronze through Nobel League. Leagues, wins, and streaks can unlock new frames and titles.
  • Weekly/Monthly leaderboard points are separate: win +3, draw +1, loss 0. Top closed-period finishes can unlock cups and special titles.
  • Link a permanent account to publish ranked results to the world, weekly, and monthly Duel leaderboards.
🪙 Atom Duel does not directly award MoleCoins. Friend and same-phone matches do not change DP or leaderboard points.

tr.title: MOLECULOX NASIL OYNANIR?
tr.html:
⚛️ Atomları it, molekülü oluştur, bilimi kurtar!Bir atoma dokun ve yön ver. Atom bir engele kadar kayar.

🎯 TEMEL AMAÇ

  • HEDEF kartındaki 2B molekül düzenini oluştur.
  • PAR veya altında bitirirsen 3 yıldız kazanırsın.
  • Geri Al ve Yeniden Başlat kampanya ilerlemeni silmez.

🧪 ÖZEL MEKANİKLER

  • ❄️ Donmuş atom hareket etmez; 🔥 Ateş buzu çözer.
  • ⚡ Elektrik bağlı grup boyunca ilerler.
  • 🍯 Yapışkan atomlar bağlandıktan sonra birlikte hareket eder.

  • Quick Match is ranked: win +25 DP, draw +3 DP, loss −10 DP. MoleCoin is 0 for every result.

  • Online Rankings: All‑Time is sorted by DP, so wins can move you up and losses can move you down. Weekly/Monthly points: win +3, draw +1, loss 0; your rank can still fall when others pass you.
